annotations.title: utilpeek: find and replace in text (literal or RE2 regex)

description: utilpeek: Find and replace in text. To sort, dedupe or number lines use text_lines. Returns the text with `find` replaced: literally, or as a regular expression on RE2 only (linear time for any pattern: no backtracking, so no ReDoS; backreferences and lookaround are refused), with \1 / \g<name> in the replacement; at most `max_replacements` (`limit_reached` reported). A pattern RE2 cannot compile is a 422 invalid_pattern (not charged). Typically under 0.5 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored.

case_sensitive.description: Match letter case exactly (default true); false ignores case.
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

find.description: Literal text, or an RE2 pattern (mode=regex; no backreferences or lookaround; \p{L} for letters).
find.title: Find

max_replacements.description: Replace at most this many matches, first to last (1-10,000, default 10,000).
max_replacements.title: Max Replacements

mode.description: literal (default: find is plain text) or regex (find is an RE2 pattern).
mode.title: Mode

multiline.description: regex: ^ and $ match at line breaks.
multiline.title: Multiline

replace.description: Replacement; regex mode: \1..\99, \g<name>, \\ for a backslash.
replace.title: Replace

name: text_replace

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
